jobs.name: compatibility-roll/evaluate
jobs.applicable_when: the weekly schedule or a manual compatibility evaluation is triggered
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside its schedule or explicit dispatch
jobs.implementation_status: immutable candidates are promoted or quarantined through a signed review pull request

jobs.name: lint/actions
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden

jobs.name: lint/contracts
jobs.applicable_when: always after phase 1
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden
jobs.implementation_status: the consolidated contract gate owns contract and generated-output drift, Basedpyright, shell lint, and Nix source-filter validation

jobs.name: lint/nix-fmt
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden

jobs.name: lint/python-lint
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden
jobs.implementation_status: Ruff checking and formatting are consolidated in this single lint job

jobs.name: lint/typos
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden

jobs.name: lint/web-check
jobs.applicable_when: web/package.json, lockfile, and tracked web/src source exist
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming each absent Web prerequisite

jobs.name: lint/markdownlint
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden

jobs.name: lint/textlint
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden

jobs.name: pytest/test-linux
jobs.applicable_when: tracked tests/**/test_*.py or tests/**/*_test.py exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming both absent pytest collection patterns

jobs.name: pytest/production-routing-mutation-audit-linux
jobs.applicable_when: tracked tests/**/test_*.py or tests/**/*_test.py exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming both absent pytest collection patterns
jobs.implementation_status: the production-routing mutation audit runs in a dedicated parallel CI job

jobs.name: package/linux
jobs.command: nix run .#tauri-build -- --bundles deb && nix run .#package-smoke -- dist/tauri/*.deb && nix run .#package-install-smoke -- dist/tauri/*.deb
jobs.applicable_when: a package-affecting path changes on a configured branch or pull request
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path and branch filters did not select the change
jobs.implementation_status: Debian resources, clean install, offline startup, upgrade, uninstall, and signing-input handoff are enforced

jobs.name: package/linux-reproducibility-build
jobs.applicable_when: a package-affecting path changes on a configured branch or pull request
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path and branch filters did not select the change
jobs.implementation_status: an independent runner builds the reproduction Debian bundle from identical inputs

jobs.name: package/linux-reproducibility
jobs.applicable_when: both independent Linux package jobs complete successfully
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path and branch filters did not select the change, or a required package build failed
jobs.implementation_status: the independently built Debian artifacts are downloaded and required to be byte-for-byte identical

jobs.name: package/windows
jobs.applicable_when: a package-affecting path changes on a configured branch or pull request
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path and branch filters did not select the change
jobs.implementation_status: the pinned native toolchain builds and smoke-tests an offline NSIS installer

jobs.name: release/linux
jobs.command: nix run .#release-check -- --tag <tag> && nix run .#check && nix run .#tauri-build -- --bundles deb
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and its version matches every release artifact
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error
jobs.implementation_status: Nix closure, Python wheel, reproducible Debian package, and checksums are produced together

jobs.name: release/windows
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and its version matches every release artifact
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error
jobs.implementation_status: the pinned native toolchain produces an NSIS installer and PyO3 wheel with checksums

jobs.name: release/github-release
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and all package jobs and signed artifact checks succeed
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error
jobs.implementation_status: verified Linux and Windows assets are merged into one immutable checksummed release

jobs.name: remote-flake/remote-flake-run
jobs.applicable_when: metadata always; app help execution after the Rust application entry point exists
jobs.not_applicable: app substeps use the canonical app guard; metadata is never skipped
jobs.implementation_status: canonical app guard and remote help probes implemented in phase 2

jobs.name: remote-flake/local-flake-run
jobs.applicable_when: always
jobs.not_applicable: forbidden
jobs.implementation_status: local flake output evaluation is unconditional; executable app resolution is owned by the remote job

jobs.name: rust-ci/build
jobs.applicable_when: at least one tracked rust/**/src/**/*.rs exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Rust source pattern
jobs.implementation_status: Rust Clippy, workspace build and tests, and immutable compatibility checks are consolidated in rust-ci-core

jobs.name: rust-ci/package
jobs.command: nix run .#worker-package-check && nix run .#ui-package-check && nix run .#cli-help-check
jobs.applicable_when: the Rust CI workflow path filters select the change; the worker subcheck additionally requires tracked Rust source
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path filters did not select the change; only the worker subcheck may be skipped by its source guard
jobs.implementation_status: immutable worker, UI and SPA, and CLI package checks are consolidated here against Nix-built products

jobs.name: rust-ci/build-windows
jobs.applicable_when: Rust workspace source exists on the Windows runner
jobs.not_applicable: workflow path filters distinguish an absent Rust change; a triggered missing workspace is an error
jobs.implementation_status: Windows has no supported native Nix runner, so the pinned rust-toolchain and Python 3.14 are installed explicitly
